description: The calls PumpPill's room posted on Solana and Robinhood Chain, newest first, each with the rule that fired (whale buy, revival, early detection, agreement between systems), the market cap at the post, the move since, the 7-day peak and whether it died. Losers are in the list. Open to everyone a few minutes behind (delay_minutes says how far); a member's claim reads it live. A count of calls is not a success rate.
name: room_calls
title: PumpPill's calls, graded
